name: Osei & Park SolarDrift Wide-Brim Cap
description: Wide-brim sun cap in structured UPF-50 cotton-analog, bleached sand with a batik-dyed underbrim in deep teal — a nod to West African and Southeast Asian textile traditions fused into one piece. Adjustable sweatband absorbs moisture and keeps BCI temple ports clear of salt irritation. Collapsible wire brim folds flat into a cargo pocket.
functionality: UPF-50 full-brim sun protection, BCI-port-safe sweatband, collapsible for pocket storage.
what_it_says: You appreciate craft and aren't going to pretend the Lake Michigan sun is anything but merciless.
story_hooks: The teal underbrim dye pattern is a specific regional batik from a place that no longer exists — someone will recognize it.
The wire brim has been bent back into shape one too many times; it's about to snap.

physical_description.visual_profile: A structured wide-brim sun cap with a relaxed, utilitarian silhouette that reads as both heritage-conscious and functionally augment-aware. The bleached sand exterior contrasts strikingly with the deep teal batik underbrim, creating visual interest when the wearer tilts their head. Projects a Tier 2-3 accessible luxury vibe — thoughtful design without ostentatious branding.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed, adjustable fit via sweatband mechanism. Wide brim (approximately 3-4 inches) provides substantial sun coverage without feeling oversized or costume-like. Structured crown maintains shape; collapsible brim sits flush against head when folded.
physical_description.primary_material: UPF-50 cotton-analog blend — a synthetic performance fabric mimicking natural cotton breathability with superior durability and solar protection. Non-reflective finish prevents glare from augmented vision systems.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly nubbled surface on exterior; soft brushed interior sweatband. Batik-dyed underbrim has subtle texture variation from the traditional resist-dye process — organic imperfection against tech-forward construction.
physical_description.color_scheme: Bleached sand exterior (off-white, warm undertone) with deep teal batik underbrim featuring organic indigo patterns — circles, spirals, and geometric motifs reminiscent of Yoruba and Javanese textile traditions.
physical_description.closures: Adjustable moisture-wicking sweatband with friction-fit sizing mechanism (no visible buckles or snaps). Collapsible brim uses embedded memory wire — folds seamlessly without mechanical closures.
distinctive_features: Batik-dyed underbrim showcasing West African and Southeast Asian heritage
Integrated sweatband with BCI temple port relief — slight padding around neural interface zones to prevent salt irritation
Collapsible memory-wire brim stores flat in cargo pocket for portability
Osei & Park brand subtly embroidered on interior sweatband in muted gray thread
UPF-50 sun protection rating visible as small text tag on interior
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 accessible luxury — heritage craftsmanship meets practical augment accommodation. Premium materials and construction without corpo-exclusivity pricing.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals cosmopolitan awareness and respect for diaspora traditions. Wearer likely navigates multiple cultural contexts; practical enough for daily GLMZ street wear, thoughtful enough for conscious consumers. Appeals to augmented workers spending long hours outdoors — construction, delivery, agriculture, maintenance crews.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to gently broken-in. Sweatband shows first-wear softening; brim retains crisp structure. Batik dye remains vibrant; sand exterior ages gracefully with slight patina over months of use.
